title: 3rd Stopping Place 3rd Truth The Comparison Of The Army Of 400 000 Nations

questions.question: In the passage, what is spring compared to in relation to life after death?
questions.answer: It is shown as a small example of people being raised again after resurrection.

questions.question: About how many examples of being brought back to life are said to appear in spring, and how fast do they appear?
questions.answer: Around three hundred thousand appear within a few weeks.

questions.question: What four repeated renewals are mentioned for a tree?
questions.answer: The tree itself, its leaves, its blossoms, and its fruits are renewed.

questions.question: What does the passage say spring shows us by returning in a way similar to earlier springs?
questions.answer: It shows steady order and the power to repeat creation again and again.

questions.question: What kinds of things are given to each species in this great army of living things?
questions.answer: Each one receives food, means of defense, special clothing or appearance, commands about its life cycle, and the tools it needs.

questions.question: How are these gifts given to the species?
questions.answer: They are given in a very orderly, accurate, timely way without mix-up, neglect, or mistake.

questions.question: Why does the passage stress that these things are given at the right time and in unexpected ways?
questions.answer: To show that this care is beyond ordinary human control and points to Divine planning and power.

questions.question: Which qualities of Allah are proven through what happens every spring?
questions.answer: His unity, oneness, uniqueness, unlimited power, and endless mercy.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying this happens within perfect lordship, rule, and wisdom?
questions.answer: It means everything is managed completely, with authority and deep purpose.

questions.question: What is written on the earth every spring, according to the passage?
questions.answer: A clear sign and announcement of Divine unity is written across the earth.

questions.question: What is meant by the “pen of Divine Determining”?
questions.answer: It means Allah’s decree and precise planning shape everything that appears in spring.

questions.question: What main lesson should a reader take from this picture of spring?
questions.answer: The careful renewal of life in spring is a strong proof of Allah’s power and His absolute oneness.

questions.question: What season is used in the passage as evidence for revival after death?
questions.answer: Spring.

questions.question: Why would spring be a fitting example for that idea?
questions.answer: Because many living things appear alive again after seeming dead or inactive.

questions.question: How many life-restorations are said to happen in spring in just a short time?
questions.answer: Three hundred thousand.

questions.question: What does the passage teach by mentioning the tree, its leaves, flowers, and fruits?
questions.answer: It teaches that renewal happens in several connected ways even within one living thing.

questions.question: What does the phrase about showing spring like the one before suggest about creation?
questions.answer: It suggests consistency, control, and the ability to repeat the same amazing work.

questions.question: What are some examples of what each species receives in this living army?
questions.answer: It receives food, protection, distinguishing features, life-stage directions, and needed equipment.

questions.question: What does the complete absence of confusion and omission help prove?
questions.answer: It helps prove that one perfect Planner is managing everything.

questions.question: Which is stronger in the passage: the idea of random growth or careful administration?
questions.answer: Careful administration.

questions.question: Why is the army image useful in this passage?
questions.answer: It helps us imagine many different groups being managed correctly at the same time.

questions.question: What does the passage say all this order proves besides power?
questions.answer: It also proves mercy, unity, and uniqueness.

questions.question: Where is the message of Divine unity said to be written?
questions.answer: On the earth and on every spring as if each spring were a page.

questions.question: If a student summed up the passage in one sentence, what would be a good summary?
questions.answer: The ordered return of life every spring shows Allah’s perfect control, mercy, and oneness.

questions.question: In the passage, what does spring act as a sample of?
questions.answer: It acts as a sample of the gathering after resurrection.

questions.question: What is the significance of the few weeks mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: They show how quickly so many living things are brought forth in an organized way.

questions.question: What do the four renewals of a tree teach about Allah’s work in nature?
questions.answer: They show detailed and repeated care in different parts of one creation.

questions.question: What does it mean that spring appears like the one before it?
questions.answer: It means the same pattern can be recreated reliably and exactly.

questions.question: Name two things given to each species besides food.
questions.answer: Protective means and special outward forms are two examples.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest by saying these things are given without mistake or delay?
questions.answer: It suggests total knowledge and control over every creature’s needs.

questions.question: How does the passage connect mercy with power?
questions.answer: It shows that the One with total power also cares for every species with compassion.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention dominicality, sovereignty, and wisdom together?
questions.answer: To show that Allah rules, manages, and does everything with perfect purpose.

questions.question: What is the effect of calling spring a “page”?
questions.answer: It presents nature as a visible message that can be read and understood.

questions.question: What is being announced on that page of spring?
questions.answer: The truth that Allah is One and unmatched.

questions.question: What conclusion about Allah should a thoughtful reader reach from this passage?
questions.answer: That only Allah can renew countless forms of life with perfect order, power, and mercy.

questions.question: What event after death is spring used to help people understand?
questions.answer: Being raised and gathered again.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the way life returns in spring?
questions.answer: It returns in a disciplined, orderly, and carefully arranged way.

questions.question: What example from a single tree is given to show repeated renewal?
questions.answer: The renewal of the tree itself, then its leaves, blossoms, and fruits.

questions.question: Why is that tree example helpful for understanding the larger message?
questions.answer: It shows that even one plant contains several clear signs of revival.

questions.question: What does each group in the great living army receive?
questions.answer: It receives the supplies and features needed for its life and role.

questions.question: What words in the passage show that this giving is flawless?
questions.answer: It is described as free from mistakes, confusion, and neglect.

questions.question: What can we infer from the fact that every species gets what it needs at the proper time?
questions.answer: We can infer that there is perfect planning and full knowledge behind it.

questions.question: Which Divine attributes are highlighted by this perfect spring order?
questions.answer: Allah’s oneness, unmatched nature, unlimited power, and vast mercy.

questions.question: What does “unexpected fashion” suggest about how provision arrives?
questions.answer: It suggests creatures receive what they need in ways they could not arrange for themselves.

questions.question: What is the meaning of the image of writing on the face of the earth?
questions.answer: It means the signs of Allah can be seen openly in the world.

questions.question: Who writes this message, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Allah writes it through His decree and determination.

questions.question: What is the main proof presented in the passage?
questions.answer: The main proof is that spring’s ordered renewal of life points clearly to Allah’s perfect unity and power.

questions.question: What central natural sign is discussed throughout this passage?
questions.answer: The return and organization of life in spring.

questions.question: How is spring linked to resurrection?
questions.answer: It is presented as a small visible example of revival after death.

questions.question: What does the short time span of a few weeks show?
questions.answer: It shows that an enormous amount of creation happens quickly but still with precision.

questions.question: How many forms of renewal are named for a tree?
questions.answer: Four are named.

questions.question: What does repeating spring in a similar way each year tell us?
questions.answer: It tells us the One who creates is fully able to repeat creation.

questions.question: Why are “distinctive garments” mentioned?
questions.answer: They point to each species receiving its own fitting form and appearance.

questions.question: What does the passage say about confusion and omission in this process?
questions.answer: It says there is none.

questions.question: What does that absence of confusion lead the reader to understand?
questions.answer: That this work comes from one perfect and all-powerful Lord.

questions.question: Besides power, what caring quality is strongly emphasized?
questions.answer: Mercy.

questions.question: What is written on every spring, in a figurative sense?
questions.answer: A declaration of Allah’s unity is written there.

questions.question: What is a strong one-sentence inference from the whole passage?
questions.answer: Since countless lives are renewed in exact order each spring, Allah alone controls and sustains all creation.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does spring serve as a sign of?
questions.answer: It serves as a sign of resurrection and gathering.

questions.question: What does the passage say happens in spring within only a few weeks?
questions.answer: Hundreds of thousands of examples of renewed life appear.

questions.question: Why does the passage focus on both large numbers and careful order?
questions.answer: To show that greatness in quantity does not reduce precision in management.

questions.question: What four parts of a tree are used to show repeated revival?
questions.answer: Its full form, leaves, flowers, and fruits.

questions.question: What does the return of spring in a familiar pattern prove about the Creator?
questions.answer: It proves that repeating creation is easy for Him.

questions.question: List three things that each species receives in the springtime army.
questions.answer: Food, protection, and the tools needed for life.

questions.question: What timing detail is important in the passage?
questions.answer: Everything reaches each species exactly when needed.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying this happens without any slip?
questions.answer: It means nothing goes wrong in the giving and arranging of what creatures need.

questions.question: Which truth is made visible through this perfect arrangement of spring?
questions.answer: The truth of Allah’s unity and unmatched rule.

questions.question: How are power and mercy shown together in the passage?
questions.answer: Allah brings vast numbers of creatures to life while also caring for each one’s specific needs.

questions.question: What is the role of Divine Determining in the final sentence of the passage?
questions.answer: It refers to Allah’s exact decree that arranges and records this order in creation.

questions.question: What overall message does the passage teach an attentive student?
questions.answer: Every spring is a visible lesson that Allah alone brings life back, provides for creation, and rules with wisdom.
